item.description: I have heard Bryan Stevenson speak and found him to be so compelling. item.description: Thank you again Marie and friends. Feel isolated and now i think i will try to learn to do this. I haven't had wine or any alcohol. Because i won't drink alone. item.title: Comment on Breaking Up With Match.com by Dee
item.description: I haven't done any dating sites, I got messages from them the week after my husband passed. What a horrible thought that was. I just can't convince myself I want another man in my life. So I'm just spending time with friends, taking classes in things that interest me, doing a little volunteering. My son lives close if I need something, the daughter lives 5 hours away with most of the grands. So I vacation with them, long weekends, mostly.
